name: Enemies Left
description: Shows how many enemies are still alive on the floor on the HUD - "Enemies left: 12 / 20" - while you explore. Its place and size are yours to set in Configuration.
author: KSFA

settings.label: Across
settings.help: Pixels from the left edge, on the game's 1920 x 1080 screen (it scales to yours).

settings.label: Down
settings.help: Pixels from the top edge, on the game's 1920 x 1080 screen.

settings.label: Text size
settings.help: 100% is the size of the game's own HUD text.

settings.label: Text colour
settings.help: It always has a black shadow, so it shows up on bright and dark floors alike.

settings.label: Also show how many the floor started with

patches.description: Where the counter goes, its size, and its words in every language
patches.sql:
INSERT OR REPLACE INTO master_const_float (id, value) VALUES ('LID_ENEMY_HUD_X', {{x}}), ('LID_ENEMY_HUD_Y', {{y}}), ('LID_ENEMY_HUD_SCALE', {{size}} / 100.0), ('LID_ENEMY_HUD_ALIGN', {{align}}), ('LID_ENEMY_HUD_COLOUR', {{colour}});
INSERT OR REPLACE INTO master_text (sct, id, snd, lang, txt, type) SELECT 'TUB', 'TXT_LID_ENEMIES_LEFT', '', column1, CASE WHEN {{show_total}} = 1 THEN column2 ELSE column3 END, 4 FROM (VALUES
  ('int', 'Enemies left: #0 / #1', 'Enemies left: #0'),
  ('esn', 'Enemigos restantes: #0 / #1', 'Enemigos restantes: #0'),
  ('deu', 'Verbleibende Gegner: #0 / #1', 'Verbleibende Gegner: #0'),
  ('fra', 'Ennemis restants : #0 / #1', 'Ennemis restants : #0'),
  ('ita', 'Nemici rimasti: #0 / #1', 'Nemici rimasti: #0'),
  ('ptb', 'Inimigos restantes: #0 / #1', 'Inimigos restantes: #0'),
  ('jpn', '残りの敵：#0 / #1', '残りの敵：#0'),
  ('kor', '남은 적: #0 / #1', '남은 적: #0'),
  ('chn', '剩餘敵人：#0 / #1', '剩餘敵人：#0'),
  ('kan', '剩余敌人：#0 / #1', '剩余敌人：#0'));
